name: Dresden
author: pierreggt
description: Map of Dresden, Germany, from the city center to Dresden Airport, spanning the surrounding Saxony towns (Radebeul, Coswig, Freital, Bannewitz, Heidenau, Weinböhla). Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring Dresden and all of its modeled surrounding municipalities.
data_source: Zensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
